Corn___Common_rust.yield_loss_risk_pct: 10% - 25% under prolonged cool, moist atmospheric conditions
immediate_actions: Monitor pustules on both upper and lower leaf surfaces.
Assess temperatures; hot dry conditions (>30°C) naturally arrest fungal reproduction.
Corn___Common_rust.chemical_control: Apply Pyraclostrobin + Fluxapyroxad if >6 pustules per leaf appear on mid-canopy prior to tasseling.
Corn___Common_rust.organic_bio_control: Sulfur-based dusts or wettable powders applied early in the infestation cycle.
Corn___Common_rust.preventative_practices: Select rust-resistant hybrids and ensure timely planting to avoid peak airborne spore arrival.

Corn___Northern_Leaf_Blight.yield_loss_risk_pct: 30% - 50% if lesions develop prior to silking stage
immediate_actions: Scout 20 consecutive corn plants across 5 field zones to quantify ear-leaf lesion thresholds.
Assess growth stage; if pre-tassel and disease is moving up canopy, prepare ground or aerial application.
Corn___Northern_Leaf_Blight.chemical_control: Apply strobilurin or triazole fungicides (e.g., Headline AMP, Trivapro) before silking if lesions exceed economic threshold.
Corn___Northern_Leaf_Blight.organic_bio_control: Foliar sprays containing Reynoutria sachalinensis extract to trigger systemic acquired resistance (SAR).
Corn___Northern_Leaf_Blight.preventative_practices: Plant hybrid corn varieties with multi-genic Ht resistance; deep-till crop residue post-harvest.

immediate_actions: Continue standard nitrogen side-dressing and moisture monitoring.
Corn___healthy.preventative_practices: Scout weekly for fall armyworm and rootworm damage during vegetative stages.

Grape___Black_rot.yield_loss_risk_pct: 50% - 100% loss of fruit clusters under humid conditions
immediate_actions: Physically remove and destroy all shriveled, black mummified berries from vines and ground.
Expose fruit clusters to sunlight and wind by selective summer shoot thinning.
Grape___Black_rot.chemical_control: Apply Myclobutanil, Mancozeb, or Ziram starting at early shoot growth (1-3 inches) through 4 weeks post-bloom.
Grape___Black_rot.organic_bio_control: Bordeaux mixture (copper sulfate and hydrated lime) applied prior to rain events.
Grape___Black_rot.preventative_practices: Train grapevines to high-wire or open canopy systems for swift moisture evaporation.

Potato___Early_blight.preventative_practices: Maintain adequate nitrogen fertility throughout vine expansion.

Potato___Late_blight.yield_loss_risk_pct: 70% - 100% total tuber rot in field and post-harvest storage
immediate_actions: Kill potato vines (flame, mechanical vine killing, or desiccant) 2 weeks before harvest if blight is active.
Destroy cull piles immediately; never leave infected tubers on field margins.
Potato___Late_blight.chemical_control: Systemic fungicides: Fluopicolide, Mandipropamid, or Cymoxanil in alternation.
Potato___Late_blight.organic_bio_control: Copper hydroxide formulations applied at 7-day intervals under cool wet forecasts.
Potato___Late_blight.preventative_practices: Use certified disease-free seed tubers. Hill soil high over developing tubers to prevent wash-down spores.

Tomato___Early_blight.chemical_control: Treat with Azoxystrobin, Pyraclostrobin, or Boscalid alternating with Mancozeb to prevent fungicide resistance.

Tomato___Early_blight.preventative_practices: Stake plants upright, avoid working in damp fields, and clear all nightshade weeds from field borders.

immediate_actions: Quarantine and remove severely infected foliage; seal in bags to prevent spore aerosolization.

Sanitize all pruning shears and stakes with 10% bleach solution.
Tomato___Late_blight.chemical_control: Apply targeted protectant/curative fungicides such as Chlorothalonil, Mancozeb, or Cyazofamid according to regional IPM thresholds.
Tomato___Late_blight.organic_bio_control: Apply copper octanoate (copper soap) or Bacillus subtilis (Serenade ASO) thoroughly on abaxial and adaxial leaf surfaces.
Tomato___Late_blight.preventative_practices: Implement a 3-year crop rotation outside the Solanaceae family. Ensure generous row spacing (minimum 24 inches) for aeration.
